top_news.title: Restore LLM Inference Capacity in Seconds with Shadow Engine Recovery in NVIDIA Dynamo
top_news.dek: NVIDIA Dynamo introduces shadow engine recovery to eliminate cold-start latency during LLM inference process failures.
top_news.brief: Shadow engine recovery maintains an idle, fully initialized engine on the same GPU as the active process. By offloading weight loading and kernel compilation from the serving path, this feature allows for near-instant failover, preventing the multi-minute downtime typically associated with cold restarts for large models.
top_news.image_alt: Architecture diagram of shadow engine failover

top_news.title: AgentHands: Generating interactive hand gestures for spatially grounded agent conversations in XR
top_news.dek: Google Research introduces AgentHands to generate interactive, spatially grounded hand gestures for XR AI assistants.
top_news.brief: As AI assistants move toward proactive, situated interaction, AgentHands addresses the need for natural non-verbal communication. The system enables agents to use hand gestures that align with physical objects in a user's environment, enhancing the realism and utility of multimodal XR conversations.
top_news.image_alt: XR interface showing AI agent using hand gestures

top_news.title: Equivariant Cellular Sheaves for Molecular Electronic Structure: Bridging Sheaf Cohomology and E(3)-Equivariant Hamiltonian Learning
top_news.dek: Researchers propose modeling molecular single-particle Hamiltonians as Laplacians of cellular sheaves to improve E(3)-equivariant learning.
top_news.brief: This paper bridges topological deep learning and molecular physics by demonstrating that molecular Hamiltonians, when expressed in a localized atomic-orbital basis, function as Laplacians on a regular cell complex. This structural insight provides a new framework for E(3)-equivariant Hamiltonian prediction, moving beyond standard message-passing networks.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the mapping of molecular orbitals to a cellular sheaf structure.

top_news.title: IBM's new Granite 4.2 models ride the wave of interest in local LLMs
top_news.dek: IBM has released its Granite 4.2 model series, emphasizing agentic capabilities and enterprise-grade deployment.
top_news.brief: IBM's latest Granite 4.2 models are designed for local execution, targeting enterprise use cases that require predictable performance and agentic workflows. The release reflects a broader industry shift toward optimizing LLMs for specific, reliable deployment environments rather than general-purpose chat.

top_news.title: Agentic Context Management: Memory and Cost as Architecture Problems
top_news.dek: New research argues that agentic failures stem from poor context management rather than reasoning limitations.
top_news.brief: The authors contend that current agentic systems fail due to inefficient handling of conversation history, tool outputs, and prompt bloat. Instead of treating this as a simple retrieval problem, the paper proposes an architectural approach to context lifecycle management to reduce token costs and improve recall accuracy.
top_news.image_alt: Flowchart illustrating agentic context lifecycle management.
